content.title: Water & Sewer Service Permits
content.summary: Permits and inspections are mandatory for the installation, repair, or disconnection of water and sewer services in Arvada, with specific guidelines for work in the right-of-way and on private property. Contractors must hold a valid General Municipal Contractor's license, and applications must include required documents such as traffic control plans and utility locate confirmations. Permit fees vary based on the work type, and all sales and use tax must be paid at permit issuance.
content.body:
Permits and inspections for the installation, repair or disconnects of water and sewer services are required by the City of Arvada. Please review the guidelines before applying for your permit for wet utility work on private property and in the right-of-way.

## Before you apply
If the work will enter the right of way, please review the Street Cut Moratorium map to determine if your project falls in a moratorium area.

- [City Street Cut Moratorium](https://arvada.maps.arcgis.com/apps/instant/sidebar/index.html?appid=a80fd7bd06ae40fb8393961eb264333f) (map)
	- If proposed work affects streets highlighted on this map, a permit is subject to approval and may require special asphalt restoration requirements.
		- Visit the [Street Cut Moratorium page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1007) for more information about work on a street in moratorium.

## Required licensing
For work in the right of way, permits will only be issued to contractors that have a valid active [General Municipal Contractor](https://www.arvadaco.gov/283/Municipal-General-Contractor) ’s license with the City of Arvada. The listed permittee is responsible for all subcontractors and anything that occurs onsite.

Contractors holding a plumbing license through the Arvada Building Department may apply for a permit to perform work on private property only. Exceptions are also made for homeowners wishing to perform repairs falling entirely on private property, however, a permit is still required. Contact the Engineering Permit Team for information on applying at 720-898-7640 or [engineeringpermits@arvada.org.](mailto:engineeringpermits@arvada.org)

## Submitting your application
Contractor applications are completed online through [Permit Portal]([NEW PORTAL URL]). You will be required to upload your submittal documents to apply.

### Required documents
For work entering the right of way, a traffic control plan must be submitted for review. See [traffic control typicals](https://www.arvadaco.gov/DocumentCenter/View/484/Traffic-Control-Guide-PDF) under resources for work on residential streets only. Work performed on a street classified as an arterial or collector will require a site specific traffic control plan.

Work on a street in moratorium will require a request letter on company letterhead for review by the Public Works Director. Visit the [Street Cut Moratorium page](https://www.arvadaco.gov/1007) for more information about work on a street in moratorium.

Applications for the demolition of water or sewer services must also include a utility plan for review. Please note that water/sewer services must be abandoned at the main with the use of a repair clamp.

Documents must be attached to the permit application. If the required documents are not attached the application will not be accepted.

### Utility locate confirmation
[Colorado 811](http://colorado811.org/) locates are the contractor's responsibility to obtain prior to work starting. Request an 811 Engineering Locate for plan design. A water/sewer service permit will not be approved without a locate confirmation number.

### Fees
Permit fees vary for the type of work being completed. Fees will be applied to the permit once the permit has been reviewed, please reference the [adopted fee schedule](https://www.arvadaco.gov/DocumentCenter/View/294/) for a complete list of right-of-way permitting fees.

### Sales & Use Tax
All sales and use tax will be paid at permit issuance. Please provide the complete job value at the time of application. Once the permit is issued, please use the permit when purchasing goods and materials for your project. If you are an Arvada Business License holder you can submit your license number for quarterly reporting. If the project is tax exempt, you will need to include your project specific tax exempt form.

### Review timelines
Complete application submittals for water/sewer service installation or repair permits can take 1-2 business days for full review and processing for approval. Permits for wet utility disconnects can take up to 5-7 business days.

## Permit issuance
Once the permit has been reviewed and approved, an email confirmation will be sent to the applicant for payment. Payments can be made by credit card through [Permit Portal]([NEW PORTAL URL]). You can also send checks or money orders to Arvada City Hall attention Engineering, 8101 Ralston Road Arvada, CO 80002.

## Required inspections
ROW Wet Utility inspections are required to be scheduled on all permits for every day crews are on site. Inspections are completed on a daily basis Monday through Friday between 8 am and 3 pm, and must be scheduled online by 6 am of the desired day of inspection. To schedule inspections, please visit [Permit Portal]([NEW PORTAL URL]) and login with your Arvada Contractor license number (AECXXXXX) and password.

Pre construction meetings are required prior to permit approval for all work on a street in moratorium. Once the water/sewer service permit application is received, a municipal inspector will reach out to the applicant to schedule this meeting. The permit will then be approved or denied pending the outcome of the pre construction meeting.

Additional inspections required for street cuts and concrete repairs:

- If there is concrete in the Right-of-Way being replaced, schedule ROW Concrete.
- If there is restoration required for a street cut, schedule ROW Asphalt.

All statuses of inspections and inspection notes are available on [Permit Portal]([NEW PORTAL URL]) by logging into your account and clicking on the permit number and then selecting the inspections tab. On completion of every inspection, an email will be sent to the contractor with an update of the inspection results.

## Closing the permit

The permit will be closed once the inspector has determined that the work has been approved and has finished the inspections. Please review [Permit Portal]([NEW PORTAL URL]) for updates. Permits with asphalt or concrete patching will be subjected to a two year review. If repairs are required, the contractor will be required to complete the repair within 14 days of notice.

## Warranty for asphalt and concrete restoration

A final warranty inspection will be completed for asphalt and concrete restoration if applicable within 1 year and 10 months of closing this permit. The contractor will be notified by the City of Arvada Engineering Division if repairs must be made prior to final acceptance of work.
